headline: All four Pakistani cueists, Rana Irfan, Asjad Iqbal, Muhammad Asif and Mubashir Raza, reached the quarterfinals of the IBSF Men's World Cup 2026 in Muscat, Oman, after winning their pre-quarterfinal matches, Express Tribune reports.

card.desc: Rana Irfan, Asjad Iqbal, Muhammad Asif aur Mubashir Raza jeet gaye

caption:
Snooker World Cup mein 4 Pakistani quarterfinal mein pohanch gaye! 🇵🇰
Express Tribune ke mutabiq Muscat, Oman mein IBSF Men's World Cup 2026 ke pre-quarterfinal mein chaaron Pakistani cueists ne apne muqable jeet liye. Rana Irfan ne India ke Aditya Mehta ko 4-0 se hara diya, Asjad Iqbal ne Iraq ke Firas Kamil Shaba ko 4-1 se, Muhammad Asif ne Qatar ke Mohanna Alobaidli ko 4-0 se, aur Mubashir Raza ne Sweden ke Belan Sharif ko 4-0 se shikast di.
Aap ke khayal mein kaun sa Pakistani yeh World Cup jeetega? Comment mein batayein 👇
